articles.dek: Banks must expose account and transaction APIs by Q2. Fintechs building on statements may need to switch.
articles.title: CBN publishes the go-live timeline for open banking in 2027
bullets: Tier-1 banks must expose account and transaction APIs by Q2 2027.
Statement-parsing products get a 12-month transition window.
Consent screens must follow a common design from the CBN.

articles.dek: The Nairobi team trained on matatu radio and 40 hours of student-labelled audio. Twi is next.
articles.title: Swahili Speech Kit passes 900 upvotes on launch day
bullets: Swahili Speech Kit crossed 900 upvotes in its first day on the board.
The model was trained on matatu radio recordings and 40 hours of labelled student audio.
A Twi model is in progress with a team in Kumasi.

articles.dek: The Kigali startup says average waiting time fell by 52 minutes after the queue screen rollout.
articles.title: Ward Health now runs patient queues in 40 Rwandan clinics
bullets: Ward Health is live in 40 clinics across Rwanda.
Average waiting time fell by 52 minutes after the queue screens went in.
The product keeps working offline when power or data drops.

articles.dek: Small merchants under GH₵ 5,000 a month pay nothing until March. Payment startups expect more QR adoption.
articles.title: MTN MoMo cuts merchant fees in Ghana to 0.5%
bullets: Merchant fees drop to 0.5% from December.
Merchants under GH₵ 5,000 a month pay nothing until March.
Startups expect a jump in QR payments at market stalls.

articles.dek: The round will take Salaro into Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire. Three Hentity makers were early customers, including Ledgerline.
articles.title: Paystack alumni raise $12M seed for payroll across West Africa
bullets: Salaro, a payroll and payslip tool for SMEs, raised a $12M seed led by a Lagos fund.
The money goes to Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire launches, plus statutory filings (PAYE, pension, NHF) in each country.
Founders previously built payroll at Paystack. Ledgerline and two other Hentity products already integrate with it.

channels.pinned: Maker AMA today at 16:00 WAT · Ada and Chidi answer by voice
channels.description: Product room · makers answer here first

comments.body: Tried it on a GTBank statement and it got 47 of 50 transactions right. Any plans for Ghana Mobile Money?
Thank you Kwame! MTN MoMo Ghana is in testing now; Telecel Cash next. Can I DM you for a sample statement?
We integrated with Salaro in March. Their PAYE export saved our customers a full day every month. Well deserved.
Ghana payroll is a different beast: SSNIT tiers, GRA. Curious how fast they can ship that.

messages.body: Morning everyone! Ledgerline is live for week 45. Would love feedback on onboarding, especially if you have ever reconciled OPay statements by hand.
Huge. What did you use for the Sheng training data?
Mostly matatu radio recordings with permission, plus 40 hours we paid students to label.
Any plans for Twi? Happy to connect you with a team in Kumasi.
We just crossed 900 upvotes. Thank you, Nairobi! Asante sana to everyone who tested the beta.
Ward Health moved up to #3 · 812 upvotes

messages.transcript: Congratulations to everyone launching this week. If you are building for farmers in Ghana, come and find me in feedback-swap, I will test anything with a USSD flow.

messages.body: Tried Ward Health at a clinic in Joburg last month. The queue screen alone saved the nurses an hour a day.
CBN just published the new open banking timelines
Swap: I review yours, you review mine?
Does it handle Moniepoint exports yet? Half my customers moved over this year.

messages.transcript: Not yet, but it is the next import we are shipping. Chidi has it working on our test files.

messages.body: Moniepoint CSV import ships Friday. If you want early access, reply here and we will flip it on for you.
